instruction: A clean, realistic documentary photograph in a medium full shot captures a bright indoor ballet studio with large windows. On the right, the woman in a black long-sleeved top and white tights (R1) sits on a white wooden platform with her knees bent, looking down thoughtfully with hands on her leg. On the left, the young girl in a black crop top and shorts (R2) sits next to her in a similar resting pose, looking forward. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural side light, creating a calm and clean atmosphere.
